name: Rigid Parametric Alignment
aliases: Rigid Parametric Alignment — Closed-form Rigid Alignment, Horn's Method, Horn's Method for Trajectory Alignment, Rigid Alignment via SVD
definition: A differentiable solver that estimates a 3D rigid transformation T ∈ SE(3) from correspondences by minimizing the reprojection error in a closed form using Singular Value Decomposition (SVD).
summary: Rigid Parametric Alignment computes a 3D rigid transformation from point correspondences via closed-form SVD, distinguishing itself from iterative methods by solving the problem in a single deterministic step.
